description: Synthetic neobank for gig workers — exercises the brand_analyst agent against a known-good context.

chunks.text: Hero. We are a compliance-first neobank for India's gig-economy salaried workforce. Our pitch is that traditional banks reject 60% of platform workers' loan applications; we approve them at 92% within 24 hours.

Pricing. Three tiers: starter (free), growth (₹199/mo + 1.5% FX margin), enterprise (custom). All tiers include UPI, instant credit-line, and full RBI-compliant KYC. Pay only on active borrower per RBI digital lending guidelines (2022).

Founders' note. We built this after our co-founder's Swiggy delivery partner couldn't open an account at four major banks despite a stable 18-month income on the platform. The compliance burden falls on the lender, not the borrower — that's the whole product thesis.

tasks.task: Extract the company's brand positioning, tone, and 3 value propositions.
